name: DWX Developer World Experience 2027
description: four-day developer conference: AI, cloud, web and .NET
note: on-site, German and English; workshops Mon 28 Jun, sessions 29 Jun - 1 Jul; prices in the ticket shop
details:
DWX (formerly Developer Week, moved from Nuremberg to Mannheim in 2025) is a large German developer conference with 2,000+ attendees, 150+ speakers and 170+ sessions.

Day one has half- and full-day workshops, days two to four about 60-minute sessions plus meetups, get-togethers and a casino night. Topics: AI and generative AI, cloud, web, .NET, DevOps. In the Rhein-Neckar region, so also relevant for the local it-events list.
